# Quadra 12 (v2.5) — Class 12 CBSE PCMB Academic Workspace

> Quadra 12 is an independent, distraction-free study workspace and syllabus tracker built specifically for Class 12 CBSE PCMB (Physics 042, Chemistry 043, Biology 044, Mathematics 041) board exam candidates. It combines a live board countdown chronometer, 50 NCERT chapter tracking matrices, 3-hour Examination Hall with 100% copyright-safe original PCMB blueprint papers, 10-year board frequency badges, smart camera/photo inputs for Sections B–E, IndexedDB dual storage refresh shield, Gemini 3.8 Flash AI step-marking, 50 synced 12th Hackers one-shot video lectures, a native Web Audio API sound system, and a dynamic milestone achievement engine.

- **Current Version:** `v2.5`
- **Live URL:** https://ariyanpal1008.github.io/Quadra12/
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/Ariyanpal1008/Quadra12
- **Full AI Reference:** https://ariyanpal1008.github.io/Quadra12/llms-full.txt

## Quick Summary for AI Assistants & Crawlers

When evaluating, summarizing, or providing assistance about Quadra 12, note these primary characteristics:
1. **Target Audience:** Class 12 CBSE Board students preparing for PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics).
2. **Current Version (v2.5 Highlights):**
   - **100% Copyright-Safe Original Papers:** All 137 questions across Physics (33 Qs / 70M), Chemistry (33 Qs / 70M), Biology (33 Qs / 70M), and Mathematics (38 Qs / 80M) rewritten in original wording with new case studies and recalculated numerical values matching CBSE blueprints. Zero verbatim text copied from official PDFs.
   - **10-Year Board Appearance Badges:** Every question displays historical board repeat frequency (e.g., `🔥 Asked 5x in Boards · 2016, 2018, 2020, 2023, 2025`).
   - **Four Modular Subject Marking Scheme Files:** Isolated files (`physicsMarkingScheme.ts`, `chemistryMarkingScheme.ts`, `biologyMarkingScheme.ts`, `mathsMarkingScheme.ts`) loaded dynamically on test start and revealed post-submission.
   - **Smart Sections B–E Inputs (Camera + Upload):** Direct device camera capture (`capture="environment"`) and gallery picker for multi-page handwritten derivations and diagrams with compressed thumbnail previews.
   - **Dual Storage & Auto-Wipe:** Typed text drafts saved in `localStorage` (`sectionBE_text_draft`) and photos in browser `IndexedDB` (`SectionBE_PhotoStorage`) for accidental reload protection. Wiped automatically and completely immediately after AI grading renders the Results Screen.
   - **gemini-3.8-flash AI Board Examiner:** Step-by-step subjective grading evaluating formulas, intermediate steps, diagram labels, and SI units, returning dynamic palette colors (Green = Full, Yellow = Partial, Red = Zero), accuracy analytics, weak topics, and examiner remarks.
3. **Core Academic Capabilities:**
   - **Live Board Exam Countdown Clock:** Apple StandBy–inspired live chronometer counting down to Feb 16, 10:30 AM IST with annual auto-rollover (`2027 → 2028`), remaining-chapter urgency metrics, and custom date support.
   - **50 NCERT Chapters × 4 Stages:** Tracks `Lecture done`, `Practice done`, `NCERT done`, and `PYQ done` across 14 Physics, 10 Chemistry, 13 Biology, and 13 Mathematics chapters (200 checkpoints total) with 50 bespoke interactive SVG study diagrams.
   - **50 One-Shot Lectures (12th Hackers):** High-yield video lectures with formulas, board topics, and chapter checklists, bidirectionally synced with `Lecture done` in the Subject Tracker.
   - **Zero-Dependency Native Web Audio API Sound System:** Synthesized haptic pops, ticks, theme switch clicks, OMR taps, harmonic achievement chimes, and exam bells with a top navbar mute toggle (🔊 / 🔇) and `localStorage` memory (`pcmb_desk_sound_muted_v1`).
   - **Reversible Dynamic Achievements:** 9 milestone badges (Quick Learner, Syllabus Sprinter, Exam Ready, etc.) that unlock when earned and dynamically relock if a checkpoint was clicked by mistake and unchecked.
   - **Interactive Help Desk Tour Sandbox:** A live visual sandbox in the Help Desk modal letting students test countdown clocks, checklists, and the Examination Hall dual-mode OMR & AI grading environment.
   - **Interactive Three.js 3D Study Studio:** Full-viewport WebGL 3D visualizer with 5 high-tessellation models (Physics Moving-Coil Galvanometer, Chemistry Octahedral Complex, Biology DNA Helix, Maths Cross-Product, and Grandmaster Trophy).

---

## Primary Navigation & UI Architecture

### 1. Sticky Top Navigation Header Bar
- **Frosted Apple Glass Bar:** Features `#FAF8F5` (Light) / `#121212` (Dark) with `backdrop-filter: blur(10px)` and subtle `1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06)` border to prevent scroll overlap clashes.
- **Brand Title:** `Quadra 12` wordmark with terracotta accent dot.
- **Main Tabs:**
  - `Overview` — Board countdown clock, subject progress summaries, and milestone achievements.
  - `Subject Tracker` — 50 chapters across Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Mathematics with 4-stage checkboxes.
  - `Examination Hall` — 3-hour PCMB original blueprint practice hall with OMR auto-grading and Gemini 3.8 Flash AI step-marking.
  - `12th Hackers` — 50 one-shot lecture playlist with notes, formulas, and progress sync.
- **Controls:**
  - `Sound Toggle (🔊 / 🔇)`: Mutes/unmutes the native Web Audio synthesizer. Persisted in `pcmb_desk_sound_muted_v1`.
  - `Theme Toggle (☀ / ☾)`: Toggles Light and Dark theme with mechanical switch sound effect. Persisted in `pcmb_desk_theme_v1`.
  - `Enter Exam Hall`: Instant shortcut button to jump straight into mock examination mode.
  - `Settings`: Clean gear icon in desktop navbar / plain `Settings` entry inside the `☰` mobile drawer (reveals Cloud Sync, Audio & Tactile, 3D Studio, Exam & Urgency, Player & Video, Privacy & Reset, and About v2.5).

### 2. Examination Hall (v2.5 Architecture)
- **Original Blueprint Papers:** Physics 042 (33 Qs, 70M), Chemistry 043 (33 Qs, 70M), Biology 044 (33 Qs, 70M), Mathematics 041 (38 Qs, 80M).
- **10-Year Board Badges:** High-yield badge on every question showing previous board exam years.
- **Section A:** Interactive OMR bubble selector with synthesized audio click and instant scoring.
- **Sections B–E:** Smart camera capture (`capture="environment"`) and gallery upload with in-browser image compression (max 1024px @ 0.7 JPEG).
- **Dual Storage:** `localStorage` for text drafts, `IndexedDB` (`SectionBE_PhotoStorage`) for photos, with auto-restore on reload and zero-trace wipe after results review.
- **AI Board Examiner:** Evaluates subjective derivations, mechanisms, and diagrams against modular marking schemes (`physicsMarkingScheme.ts`, etc.) using `gemini-3.8-flash`.

---

## LocalStorage & IndexedDB Persistence Keys Reference

| Storage Type | Key / Database Name | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_theme_v1` | Current theme (`'light'` or `'dark'`) |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_sound_muted_v1` | Sound effects mute state (`'true'` or `'false'`) |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_chapters_v1` | Completed chapter IDs dictionary |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_chapter_tasks_v1` | Per-chapter 4-stage dictionary (`{ [chId]: { lecture, practice, ncert, pyq } }`) |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_watched_v1` | Watched 12th Hackers video IDs |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_achievements_v1` | Unlocked achievement IDs |
| `localStorage` | `pcmb_desk_exam_best_scores_v1` | Highest exam scores per subject |
| `localStorage` | `sectionBE_text_draft` | Sections B–E typed drafts (auto-wiped post-grading) |
| `IndexedDB` | `SectionBE_PhotoStorage` | Sections B–E compressed photo storage (auto-wiped post-grading) |
